title: European survey for endometrial cancer patients: Acute and long-term side-effect (Expression XXI)
summary: The Expression XXI survey (SARA) asks patients with endometrial cancer about short- and long-term side effects, their disease, and its treatment. How do these affect their quality of life? The aim of the survey is to record patients' experiences and perspectives with regard to their therapy and the associated time and financial constraints. The survey aims to identify potential factors that have a positive influence on the course of the disease and life expectancy.
